fact: On 17 June 2025 the Tribunal de Paix de Kinshasa/Gombe convicted journalist Patrick Lokala, arrested 7 October 2024, of spreading false information through social networks and computer systems and online harassment, with six months and a fine of 5,000,000 CDF.
title: RDC: Le journaliste Patrick Lokala condamné à 6 mois de servitude pénale
